DI1.current_stage_objective: Establish whether the idea is sufficiently credible, bounded, and safe to justify a controlled pilot.
DI1.next_stage_objective: Test technical, operational, user, value, integration, monitoring, and scalability hypotheses under controlled realistic conditions.

criteria.title: Problem validated
criteria.description: Evidence establishes that a real and relevant problem exists for the intended users or operation.
criteria.user_action: confirm the problem and who or what it affects

criteria.title: Solution hypothesis plausible
criteria.description: The proposed solution has a credible relationship to the problem and is plausible enough to test.
criteria.user_action: explain why the proposed solution is plausible

criteria.title: Initial evidence available
criteria.description: At least some relevant evidence supports or tests the problem and solution hypotheses.
criteria.user_action: provide initial evidence supporting the problem and solution hypotheses

criteria.title: Controlled pilot scope defined
criteria.description: A bounded and feasible pilot can be run to test the important hypotheses without implying production deployment.

criteria.title: Accountable owner identified
criteria.description: An accountable owner is identified for the controlled pilot and its follow-up decisions.

criteria.title: Risk acceptable for experimentation
criteria.description: The proposed controlled pilot avoids obvious unacceptable safety, data, compliance, or operational risk.

criteria.title: Realistic performance validation
criteria.description: DI2 is expected to test solution performance using controlled realistic or live-like evidence.
criteria.user_action: validate performance with controlled realistic or live-like evidence

criteria.title: Integration feasibility validation
criteria.description: DI2 is expected to establish whether the solution can integrate with the relevant workflow and systems.
criteria.user_action: validate integration with the relevant workflow and systems

criteria.title: Operational value validation
criteria.description: DI2 is expected to test the operational or business value hypothesis with measurable evidence.
criteria.user_action: validate the measurable operational or business value hypothesis

criteria.title: User adoption validation
criteria.description: DI2 is expected to test whether intended users can and will use the solution in the controlled workflow.
criteria.user_action: validate adoption with the intended users

criteria.title: Monitoring needs established
criteria.description: DI2 is expected to identify the monitoring, fallback, and operating controls needed for later stages.
criteria.user_action: establish the monitoring, fallback, and operating controls needed for later stages

criteria.title: Scalability signals observed
criteria.description: DI2 is expected to gather early evidence about repeatability and constraints beyond the controlled pilot.
criteria.user_action: collect early evidence about repeatability and constraints beyond the pilot

criteria.title: Controls before live-data connection
criteria.description: Applicable cybersecurity and data-governance conditions must be completed before live data is connected.
criteria.user_action: complete the required cybersecurity and data-governance controls before connecting live data

criteria.title: Evidence shows solution is not viable
criteria.description: Actual evidence shows the proposed solution cannot credibly address the problem in a controlled pilot.
criteria.user_action: address the evidence showing that the proposed solution is not viable

criteria.title: Unacceptable safety risk
criteria.description: Actual evidence identifies a safety risk that cannot be acceptably controlled during the proposed pilot.
criteria.user_action: resolve the unacceptable safety risk identified for the pilot

criteria.title: No feasible pilot design
criteria.description: Actual evidence shows there is no bounded and feasible experiment capable of testing the hypothesis.
criteria.user_action: define a bounded and feasible pilot design

criteria.title: Prohibited data or compliance condition
criteria.description: Actual evidence identifies a data or compliance prohibition that prevents the proposed pilot from proceeding.
criteria.user_action: resolve the data or compliance condition preventing the pilot
